entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A dragon-worshipping planeswalker from Tarkir, once Bolas's servant and unwitting releaser of the Eldrazi, who returns home hearing a voice and seeking the door.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An ancient and malevolent elder dragon planeswalker who broke Sarkhan's will and made him a servant, sending him to the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The dragon whose name Sarkhan finally recalls as the one who spoke to him and whom he sought.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: Sarkhan's hordechief in the Mardu Horde who demands total obedience and sends him to fight the Sultai.

entities.name: Malactoth
entities.description: An old dragon of Jund who was a true challenge before he fell.

entities.name: Mardu Horde
entities.description: The warlike horde clan of Tarkir, led by hordechiefs, in which Sarkhan served as a wing leader.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A clan with naga and sorcerers fought by Sarkhan's wing on the Mardu border.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: A clan Zurgo derides as sandalfoot thinkers.

entities.name: Whisperers
entities.description: Hooded mountain folk who remember the dragons and chant of their voices.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Sarkhan's home world, ravaged by clan wars and where dragons are extinct.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where Sarkhan entered the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A fierce plane of sky tyrants and dragon-hunting tribes where Sarkhan hunted dragons.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The mysterious chamber on Zendikar where Sarkhan stood watch and the Eldrazi were released.

entities.name: Qal Sisma Mountains
entities.description: The snowy mountains where Sarkhan went and met the whisperers.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The plane-ravaging beings Sarkhan unwittingly helped unleash.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol, mind unraveling, returns to Tarkir in disgrace and begins to hear a voice.
events.quote: I return in disgrace because no other plane will have me.

events.summary: Sarkhan recalls Bolas sending him to the Eye of Ugin to watch, and being left blinded and sleeping.
events.quote: Bolas sent me to the Eye. He told me to wait.

events.summary: Sarkhan realizes Bolas treated him as a mere pawn and dismissed him as a dragon's toy.
events.quote: I am dismissed, a dragon's toy, tossed aside and useless.

events.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan grows up among the Mardu Horde as a feared battle mage and wing leader, scorching clans of the hinterlands.
events.quote: Talent with battle magic, and natural ferocity, made me feared among the Horde.

events.summary: Flashback: sick of endless blood, Sarkhan leaves his clan for the Qal Sisma Mountains, where a figure takes his shape and he joins the whisperers' chant of dragons.
Flashback: Sarkhan returns and the hordechief Zurgo demands his obedience, sending him against the Sultai.
events.quote: The Helmsmasher grudgingly sent me forth with a wing of riders to challenge the Sultai

events.summary: Flashback: in a stalemated battle Sarkhan kills the Sultai sorcerer, finds a quiet point, hears an ancient voice and a fire dragon bursts from his soul, burning everything.
events.quote: From my soul, a being of pure fire burst into the sky.

events.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan is cast to an alien desert world and spends years watching and following dragons, seeking a king to honor.
events.quote: I spent the next years watching and following, learning all I could about the dragons.

events.summary: Flashback: on Jund Sarkhan finds the dragons magnificent but unworthy and fights alongside tribes hunting Malactoth.
events.quote: Old Malactoth— he had been a true challenge.

events.summary: Sarkhan recalls the name Ugin as the dragon he should have heeded, and hears a voice telling him to find the doorway.
events.quote: The world remembers what its people have forgotten.

events.summary: Sarkhan resolves to seek the whisperers of the mountaintops again to find the door and make Tarkir strong again.
events.quote: I will make us strong again.

relations.note: Sarkhan became Bolas's servant after his will was broken; Bolas dismissed him.
relations.quote: I sought his service, and he granted it.

relations.note: Sarkhan was a wing leader in the Horde.

relations.quote: I returned to my clan to the welcome of my warriors but not of my hordechief.

relations.note: Sarkhan fights and burns Sultai forces.
relations.quote: I charged through the confusion and cleaved the sorcerer who led them.
